dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Prime meridian: London. Shows national boundaries, towns and cities, frontier forts, trading posts, Indian villages and tribal territory, rivers and lakes, swamps, portages, and relief. Includes articles I-III of the Treaty. Scale ca. 1:4,100,000. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 747 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2: 100; 651
